description: This file defines the theme and styling configurations for a Flutter app, including color schemes, theme data, and reusable widgets like section headers and status chips, to ensure consistent visual design across the application.

classes.name: AppColors
classes.description: A class containing static color constants used throughout the app for consistent styling.

methods.name: buildOceanProfessionalTheme
methods.description: Constructs and returns a ThemeData object configured with the app's color scheme, component styles, and overall look and feel according to the Ocean Professional theme.

methods.name: subtleHeaderGradient
methods.description: Returns a BoxDecoration with a subtle linear gradient, used for headers and section backgrounds.

methods.name: sectionHeader
methods.description: Builds a styled header widget for sections, with gradient background, padding, and optional trailing widget.

methods.name: statusChip
methods.description: Creates a Chip widget with label and background color, styled for status indication.
